programme.title: 7ujuh (aka 7Seven: A Vengeful Suri)
programme.desc: 7個朋友踏上旅程,前往村長和女兒Suri經營的偏遠平房。他們舉行派對,並請求Suri擔任侍應。隨著派對逐漸失控,Suri不幸遭強暴。在自殺前,她對這7個人施下咒怨,使他們受到惡夢的纏擾。隨著這7人一個

programme.title: 模範家庭 #3
programme.desc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開

programme.title: 罪慾 - 地獄門
programme.desc: 藝人尹青透過一個靈異電視節目闖入地獄之門,並與已故好友美琪重逢。在美琪的墓園,尹青遇見了美琪的丈夫東升,隨後一系列詭異的靈異事件接連發生。尹青將東升帶回節目,讓美琪揭露了丈夫的婚外情和導致她死亡的陰謀

programme.title: The Elite of Devils
programme.desc: 五名大學生受委派前往一座神祕莊園進行專題研究,並結識了上流名媛莎拉吉夫人,卻發現她隱藏著致命祕密。隨著她的惡魔力量逐漸覺醒,原本的學術之旅瞬間化為生死逃亡,他們必須對抗統治階層延續數百年的詛咒。

programme.title: 紙人回魂
programme.desc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的

programme.title: Chop Chop
programme.desc: 一個寧靜的晚上,一名患精神病的連環殺手擾亂了年輕夫婦的平淡生活。當這對夫婦為生存而戰時,他們隱藏多年的秘密亦隨之揭開,期間更意外地被牽連到黑社會的地下世界中。

programme.title: 鬼新娘
programme.desc: 方明在趕路途中邂逅神秘年輕女子冷秋屏,兩人情投意合並私訂終身。婚後方明驚覺妻子竟是受邪靈操控、被迫吸取男子精氣的亡魂,但冷秋屏因真情不忍加害。最終在道士相助下,方明擊敗邪靈救出愛妻,然而人鬼殊途,兩人於晨光中淒然訣別,冷秋屏含淚投胎轉世。

programme.title: 霹靂十傑
programme.desc: 本片是少林三部作的第三部。劉家輝仍飾演三德和尚,為要保護自持功夫了得便與大清高手結怨的少年英雄方世玉,差點也令少林寺陷入險境。

programme.title: 暗渠
programme.desc: 故事講述偵緝警長趙敬才因一次行動,連累下屬被劫匪擊斃,而被上司指責處事魯莽,改派督察邱正明接辦案件。敬才與正明辦案作風迥異,衝突日多。職業殺手利子健受雇來港狙殺殷商徐文,豈料行動時卻誤中副車,僅殺死徐文之助手;當徐文查得殺手為子健後,急欲除之。警方接獲線報,即派正明與敬才率隊出發,阻止黑幫火拼……

programme.title: 書劍恩仇錄
programme.desc: 乾隆原來並非皇位繼承人,而在出生時被調包,但他一直被蒙在鼓裡,直至地下組織紅花會的人相告。而紅花會總舵主陳家洛是其同胞兄弟。兩弟兄因身世和利益必需身不由己地彼此對抗…

programme.title: 怒海情仇
programme.desc: 故事描述,青年漁夫魯金虎與漁女小玉自幼相好;土豪獨子耀祖,垂涎小玉美色,時藉故親近;一天耀祖欺負寡婦五嫂,金虎抱不平,幾動武,惹小玉誤會金虎與五嫂有不尋常關係…

programme.title: 武林聖火令
programme.desc: 尹天仇的父母因一對武林聖火令﻿遭人暗算身亡,他和妹妹分別被忠奸兩派收養撫育,兄妹各持一半聖火令,習得絕世武功。起初兩人勢同水火,卻在揭開身世秘密後攜手合作,共同為父母報仇雪恨。

programme.title: 女秀才
programme.desc: 聞蜚蛾自幼女扮男裝從父習武,後更考得秀才功名,堪稱文武全才。同窗好友杜子中與魏撰之雖與蜚蛾日夕相對,均不知其是女兒身。聞母見女兒年紀不小,不該再扮男裝,勸蜚蛾選撰之或子中為夫婿。不料蜚娥與二人情誼相同,一時無法抉擇,遂決定由天定奪,怎知陰差陽錯,選婿之箭落於撰之手中。蜚娥後悔不已,才知自己意屬子中…

programme.title: 浣花洗劍
programme.desc: 太湖決戰前夕,白水宮主人被東瀛劍客所傷。於是,他囑咐其弟寶玉代尋找解藥。途中寶玉偶遇關外的小公主,二人一見鍾情。但原來小公主的背後卻隱藏著一個重大陰謀…

programme.title: 乾隆下江南
programme.desc: 乾隆為體察民情,撇下侍衛假扮商人微服出訪江南,期間得知衙門有貪官欺壓百姓,導致民不聊生。這時乾隆遇上一名清廉的賣菜青年,二人合力教訓貪官一頓。最後,青年更被獲封為皇帝的近身侍衛。

programme.title: 雙俠
programme.desc: 宋朝康王被困於金營巨宅,四周被武林高手嚴密看守。兩名身懷絕技的義士必須克服重重困難,完成看似不可能的任務,設法救出康王。

programme.title: 雲泥
programme.desc: 女主角熊素素因不能接受機師男友意外身亡而患上精神分裂症,一天巧遇留學歸來的精神科醫生黎易非,多次奇幻的相遇令易非和素素捲入三角戀和複雜的內心糾結之中。

programme.title: 雜技亡命隊
programme.desc: 故事描述,土匪出身的軍人韓佩昌發動叛變,殺死師長楊宗,竊居其位,楊家只得長子大英一人逃出生天。大英志切報仇,結果未得手已告命喪;其好友陳風、梁國仁、傅全義、辛成決替其復仇…

programme.title: 野姑娘
programme.desc: 金小芳是一位活潑且無畏的鄉村少女,面對惡霸從不退縮,總是勇敢反抗。當她揭露了唐家大少爺的陰謀後,立刻引來他的狠毒報復。幸好,她心儀的男子大海及時挺身而出相救。兩人能否攜手對抗險惡命運,改寫結局?

programme.title: 沒有老公的日子
programme.desc: 黃太太獨力撫養兒子Alex成人,與媳婦阿彤一起生活。豈料Alex意外逝世,死前道出外遇女友黑仔已懷有身孕。結果三名沒有老公的女人同住一室

programme.title: 仙女下凡
programme.desc: 天宮仙女七妹嚮往凡間生活,某夜偷駕祥雲下凡來到香港。初到人間的她人生地不熟,險遭不法之徒欺騙,幸得經營負債累累孤兒院的董自立相救。面對貪婪富商覬覦院址、步步緊逼,七妹屢施法術相助,卻屢遭誤解為妖魅。兩人在困境中互相扶持,情愫漸生,共同守護孤兒院的未來。

programme.title: 仙女下凡
programme.desc: 天宮仙女七妹嚮往凡間生活,某夜偷駕祥雲下凡來到香港。初到人間的她人生地不熟,險遭不法之徒欺騙,幸得經營負債累累孤兒院的董自立相救。面對貪婪富商覬覦院址、步步緊逼,七妹屢施法術相助,卻屢遭誤解為妖魅。兩人在困境中互相扶持,情愫漸生,共同守護孤兒院的未來。

programme.title: 血芙蓉
programme.desc: 故事描述清帝雍正為了鞏固統治地位,組織了一暗殺集團「血滴子」,為他殺害異見分子。時有一清廷侍衛統領韓天德者,因不值雍正所為而遭殺害,幸其妻容秋燕適不在家,幸免於難,容悲憤莫名,獨闖「血滴子」統領金罡風家,為夫報仇,終行刺失敗而回。後得棄暗投明之前「血滴子」成員馬騰及其師弟王俊相助,合三人之力終將金罡

programme.title: 獨臂刀王
programme.desc: 獨臂刀方剛與妻子二人息隱歸田,但當方剛的妻子被擄走,他唯有被迫重出江湖對付武林惡黨「八大刀王」,以救回妻子。

programme.title: 花月良宵
programme.desc: 魔術師陳子新和歌女張曉萍一次避雨,誤闖豪華大宅,曉萍被屋主以爲她是失散孫女,對她甚爲喜愛,可是引起富豪外甥不忿,設計害子新和曉萍。萍將計就計,把陰谋揭發,成功成立了歌舞團。

programme.title: 唐山五虎
programme.desc: 一位功夫師傅與三位門徒被惡霸欺淩,師徒俱敗於他拳下。三徒悲憤填膺,分別尋師學藝。半年後,惡霸壽辰之日,三徒連袂回歸,誓要與惡霸一較高下!

programme.title: 王昭君
programme.desc: 王昭君拒絕賄賂畫師,於是一直被畫師畫醜致未被皇帝看上。但皇帝初遇昭君後,驚為天人,即選中她。畫師被逐後,為報復而設計將昭君與匈奴可汗和親。皇帝因拒絕婚事即引來兩國爭戰,以致王昭君最後為了平息戰亂不得不犧牲自己。

programme.title: 七俠五義
programme.desc: 太師之子在陳州貪贓枉法,私吞皇糧,被包拯當場斬首處死。太師知道後大怒,並令人刺殺包拯,幸得展昭及時阻止,救回他一命。皇上的珍品被偷的同時,宮中又發生謀殺案,於是,皇上限定包拯要在十天內破案。展昭馬上出發搜捕兇手。包拯和展昭最後可否如期破案?

programme.title: 阿牛入城記
programme.desc: 這部喜劇描述鄉下人阿牛來港後,因生性戇直而經常被壞人利用。阿牛嘗盡低下層社會的人情冷暖,最後更被判入獄!究竟天生樂觀的他,能否吉人天相?

programme.title: 天下第一劍
programme.desc: 南劍丁夢豪是「天下第一劍」,卻敗於路過的怪和尚。丁履行諾言,跟他苦修三年石工。丁修煉期滿返回家鄉後,仍有不少武林人士冒名找他決戰,唯丁欲隱居民間,所以堅拒一切挑戰。無奈後來卻要被逼與北劍再來一場生死決鬥,究竟最後會是鹿死誰手?

programme.title: 艷陽天
programme.desc: 鋼琴師李燕南與樂隊指揮女兒陳小芸相愛,常指點她歌唱技巧。小芸在一次代替演出中一鳴驚人,得團主及花花公子杜邦傑力捧。小芸赴星馬演出,心卻惦念燕南,一夜與杜邦傑于車內發生爭執,怎料汽車失事

programme.title: 琴劍恩仇
programme.desc: 桂武和甘聯珠夫婦共闖江湖、報恩仇,得女俠紅姑之助,技藝大進,博得鴛鴦劍俠美名;桂甘今受紅姑所托,將殺人利器「鳳琴」送往家中;誰料途經飛虎寨,不慎以「鳳琴」射傷少寨主,當夜琴亦為神偷盜去

programme.title: 風流韻事
programme.desc: 本片講述了三個故事。《蕭翼賺蘭亭》講述唐太宗李世民收盡天下王羲之的書法,獨缺《蘭亭序》,御史蕭翼多才多藝,設計從辯才和尚那裡騙取《蘭亭序》《蕙蓮》以林偉圖設計謀殺李鵬飛為序幕,以李在橋上看奇書《金瓶梅》展開劇情;而《小神仙》則又由偷牛、捉姦和小神仙同藥師之間的鬥法三個小故事組成。

programme.title: 龍虎溝
programme.desc: 本片為導演岳楓於1966年執導之民初動作片,劇情主要描述,二妞收到父親遇害前寫下的仇人名單,遂連同兄長建明展開一幕奇情追凶…

programme.title: 瘋猴
programme.desc: 陳百精通「猴拳」,但卻被惡霸設計陷害,更廢了他雙手。陳百終淪落為流浪藝人,直到遇上街頭小子小侯,決將一身「猴拳」,傾囊相授。最後師徒二人聯手,勢要一雪前恥。

programme.title: 街市英雄
programme.desc: 本片講述洪熙官被投靠清廷之武林敗類高進忠追殺,身受重傷,市井英雄朱才、陳阿全、梁天寶安排洪藏身於豆腐店中,並為他買藥治傷。高進忠探得洪藏身之處,暗囑手下廣佈眼線,以便將洪一舉成擒

programme.title: 街市英雄
programme.desc: 本片講述洪熙官被投靠清廷之武林敗類高進忠追殺,身受重傷,市井英雄朱才、陳阿全、梁天寶安排洪藏身於豆腐店中,並為他買藥治傷。高進忠探得洪藏身之處,暗囑手下廣佈眼線,以便將洪一舉成擒

programme.title: 小毒龍
programme.desc: 故事描述,江湖出現一貧僧打扮名喚小毒龍之殺手,嫉惡如仇,專殺江湖敗類。她乃大悲寺瘋僧之門徒,亦即「毒龍劍」的傳人李寶珠;她獨來獨往神出鬼沒,歹徒聞風喪膽。她身背父仇,待中秋與仇人在十字坡一決生死。陳仕倫為李之表哥,乃鐵扇子之高徒,率十字坡鄉民嚴陣以待,助李抗敵…

programme.title: 邪完再邪
programme.desc: 女鬼劉阿翠鍾情以前鄰居馬素,欲與其結合,央求父親攜同金銀珠寶向馬提親,撮合一段人鬼姻緣,馬素年青憨直,不願與鬼為伍,堅決拒絕,實則彼暗戀已有男友之鄰居紅卜卜,阿翠洞悉其情,決定伺機行動。

programme.title: 金印仇
programme.desc: 戴天仇自幼習武,矢志為父報仇。彼時其殺父仇人,到處為非作歹。戴上路途中遇上女扮男裝的吳小燕,並突遭多名幫會中人毒打,吳遂求父允其把戴帶返家中養傷。戴竟因此得以混入仇人地盤,希望可乘機報仇

programme.title: 人皮燈籠
programme.desc: 趙春方曾於決鬥敗於龍帥之手下。七年後,龍帥為在賞燈大會上奪魁,往尋趙春方代為製造別緻燈籠。趙春方藉此暗中佈下復仇大計。龍帥之妻無固失蹤後,他驚聞有關人皮燈籠的傳說,並開始懷疑趙春方與失蹤事件有關

programme.title: 沖霄樓
programme.desc: 改編自俠義小說《七俠五義》,人物繁多,情節多變,難得張徹處理得有條不紊,角色性格分明。故事講述襄陽王在王府中,建造的沖霄樓機關密佈,又廣招花蝴蝶花沖、神手大聖鄧車和小諸葛沈仲元等江湖俠士加盟,伺機造反。包公得悉襄陽王叛跡,乃命門生顏春敏前往調查。

programme.title: 青春戀
programme.desc: 酷愛音樂的留學生李英偉臨危受命替老父接管公司,其嬉皮士形像為祖母不屑。李的公司職員林仲鵬乘機製造事端,圖謀奪取其總經理之職位。李之青梅竹馬朋友王鳳不忍見李受屈,化身金髮美人巧施妙計助他解困,自此李對此神秘女郎一見鍾情 。

programme.title: 少林搭棚大師
programme.desc: 本片是少林三部作的第二部,講述劉家輝飾演的周仁傑一心要去少林寺學功夫,最後竟扮成寺中的三德和尚,並創出「搭棚式」的少林武藝。

programme.title: 魂斷奈何天
programme.desc: 良才見秋容貌美,心懷不軌,竟將其迷姦。秋容醒來後為良才甜言蜜意所惑,相信他稟明父母後會娶她為妻。誰知數月後,良才音訊全無,秋容更發現自已懷有身孕,於是馬上去找良才。可惜那時秋容才發現良才已另娶名門閨秀為妻,更打算將秋容滅口…

programme.title: 江湖子弟
programme.desc: 涉世未深的劉大江與結拜兄弟因劫金事件反目成仇,慘遭離間追殺,僥倖撿回一命後淪為打劫賭檔的小混混,卻獲歐陽幫主賞識。在女保鏢金燕協助下展開復仇,而黑旗門遺孀張玫瑰也因暗生情愫而對他網開一面。幾方勢力在幫派恩怨與愛恨糾葛中激烈角力,最終引爆一場江湖浩劫。

programme.title: 82家房客
programme.desc: 延續經典喜劇《72家房客》的成功,本片講述一羣住在香港唐樓的租客被發展商強行迫遷的故事。有些租客願意接受金錢賠償,但有些卻堅決反對。收購計劃最終又會否破壞鄰里間的和諧?

programme.title: 鐵旗門
programme.desc: 正派「鐵旗門」與反派「神鷹堂」,一直對立。一次,「神鷹堂」堂主以向「鐵旗門」陪罪為辭,邀「鐵旗門」門主鐵麟偕弟子往總壇喝酒;鐵認為內中有詐,不宜前往,但大弟子曹風則力言將計就計,若彼等有所行動,就乘機將他們消滅,鐵允之。「神鷹堂」果然十面埋伏,鐵等將敵人逐一殲滅;惟鐵竟在混亂中遇害,卻未知死於誰手…

programme.title: 春暖花開
programme.desc: 故事描述,陳太太有女潔玉及美玉,潔玉已工作,美玉仍求學。適逢陳家有空房出租,少奇來租,一談即合;潔玉三個姊姊,皆與租客結婚,所以潔玉表姊趙靜蘭之母決仿效陳家租房選婿。未幾,一醫科學生欣農來租房,趙母見他是理想快婿,忙出租。原來少奇與欣農是同學,少奇老成寡言,被潔玉、美玉視為怪人,欣農則只顧談戀愛…

programme.title: 少林英雄榜
programme.desc: 少林寺主持安排至善禪師前往武當道長處,學習獨特的功夫技能。在路途中,他遭遇了清兵與明軍之間的激烈鬥爭,同時還需召集少林弟子重建被燒毀的少林寺。

programme.title: 女俠賣人頭
programme.desc: 俠女花碧蓮愛上鄰村的駱宏勛,其父花振芳去說親,卻遭駱母拒絕。碧蓮深心不忿,找上駱家,把宏勛打倒來消氣。後碧蓮為救人而得罪賭棍萬三句,萬率眾圍殺碧蓮,幸宏勛及時趕來相救。萬之主人王倫知悉一切後,重金收買知府,將宏勛打下冤獄。碧蓮往探監,見宏勛奄奄一息,遂隻身闖進王倫練武場,大戰眾強徒,並取下王倫助手首

programme.desc: 本片是根據網路小說〈上海之吻〉改編,是一部講述年輕人間純真愛情經歷的電影,反映了當代青年真摯純真的情感生活。影片基調積極向上,節奏明快輕鬆,表達細膩。表達了年輕人對純美愛情的嚮往。n 北京機場,新星報社的記者齊妙(崔奕飾)偶然目擊了剛

programme.desc: 西柳鎮西柳村村長趙保群,大學畢業,在村長的位置上工作了七年。然而,令他魂牽夢繞的是對相聲的執著。這份執著源於他對相聲的熱愛,也源自於他深深知道富裕起來的農民對文化藝術的渴求。西柳村比鄰西柳服裝市場,趙保群身居“鬧市卻心無旁騖。他在村裡成立

programme.desc: 《劍客風雲》是系列武俠電影《長安俠影》的第五部,也可以當作長安俠影系列的番外篇。n 影片主要講述了江湖大俠李禦風因為厭倦了官場紛爭,與李世民辭行打算返鄉歸隱。不料長安城附近忽然紛傳有女妖挖取人心練功,一時間無論民間還是江湖都

programme.title: 保衛養老院
programme.desc: 白石村能人張大河為賺大錢,決定將“夕陽紅養老院轉為農家樂,這讓已適應養老院生活的老人們措手不及。老人們各尋養老之處,最後只剩下綽號“樹爺的老人陳青松。樹爺無兒無女,房子拆遷,無處可去,他拒絕賠償,耗在養老院就是不搬。為逼走樹爺,張大河使

programme.title: 楊家溝的天

programme.title: 燦爛的她
programme.desc: 慈祥寬容的奶奶(惠英紅 飾)與十二年前意外走失的孫女(劉浩存 飾)重逢,祖孫二人從生疏到彼此依偎。相處期間,她們身上的秘密也逐漸被揭開。最終奶奶拯救了這個本對人生不抱希望的“孫女。

programme.title: 鐵血陽泉
programme.desc: 1947年隨著炮火不斷推進,陽泉獲得解放,中國共產黨在一片廢墟上建立了第一座人民城市。全片以建設城市為主線,以清除敵特和個人情感為副線,敘寫了為全國其他城市解放建市提供借鑒的陽泉解放建市歷程。

programme.title: 興安嶺上
programme.desc: 本片講述了鄂倫春族部落首領蓋山和東北抗聯將領王大虎與日本侵略者的鬥爭中結下深厚革命友誼,義結金蘭。並帶領鄂倫春族人在大興安嶺一帶協助抗聯共同抗擊日本侵略者的故事。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #1
programme.desc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生

programme.title: 動物長青術 #1
programme.desc: 我們在本集認識一些動物長老,牠們幫我們瞭解與長壽相關的心理機制,以及長壽動物為其社區帶來的正面社會價值

programme.title: 動物長青術 #2
programme.desc: 認識一些黃昏戀人,探索他們性長壽,以及晚年生育能力仍然旺盛的原因

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #2
programme.desc: 安斯利到訪加勒比海地區,他在後巷冒險尋覓真正的當地食物他與當地人共度時光,和好味道先生在海灘上做煎餅和超讚的魚糕,並嘗試了有史以來最辣的辣醬

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #3
programme.desc: 安斯利前往冰島雷克雅未克,發現一種真心刺激的傳統和現代美食他用大蒜牛油烹調經典的挪威龍蝦,還有醃三文魚和檸汁魚生,麥芽麵包和在間歇泉中焗製的蛋糕

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #4
programme.desc: 安斯利的街頭美食長徵於大阪落幕,他在當地發現了製作大阪燒的藝術,有點像用班㦸包裹的英國早餐,嘗試日本風的小食,並製作生蠔天婦羅和辣蝦烏冬

programme.title: 山繆傑克森:給我聽好
programme.desc: 憑藉無出其右的職業道德,山繆傑克森作為電影史上最傑出人物之一的地位毋容置疑這位仍然擄獲全球粉絲的心的漫威演員,一起跟進他的傳奇

programme.title: 李小龍:戰士之道
programme.desc: 李小龍,好萊塢電影的標誌性人物,武術先驅,但最重要的是,他是一位朋友《武者之路》全面審視,由最親近的人講述李小龍的傳奇

programme.title: 夏奇拉:新時代女性
programme.desc: 講述唱片銷量超過1億哥倫比亞出生的超級巨星莎琦拉的故事;還有她堅定不移的倡議和慈善努力,使她成為有類似志向的藝人和粉絲的榜樣

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #2
programme.desc: 腔棘魚通常被稱為恐龍魚,在化石記錄中佔有獨特的地位,近一個世紀前重新發現它時震驚了科學界我們跟隨它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科學家進行探險,以揭開它們更多的秘密和行為

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #3
programme.desc: 在《兩條鯊魚的故事》中,我們將看看南非海岸發現的各種各樣的鯊魚,重點關注瀕臨滅絕的路氏雙髻鯊和標誌性的大白鯊

programme.title: 野外的一年:羅莽湖 #1
programme.desc: 春天來了,遷徙的魚鷹重返公園懷孕的歐洲馬鹿下山到低地產子兩隻大公雞在山腰為了爭奪交配權,而展開一場名為力的奇觀

programme.title: 野外的一年:羅莽湖 #2
programme.desc: 現在是六月,公園沐浴在17個小時的日光之中溫暖的氣溫帶來了豐收,但對新生兒來說,夏季很重要,因牠們要學習戰鬥,覓食和躲避掠食者

programme.title: 野外的一年:羅莽湖 #3
programme.desc: 秋季是雄鹿爭相繁殖,魚鷹雛鳥開展3000英裡西非遷徙,三文魚返回牠們出生的河流,極北蝰產子的季節

programme.title: 野外的一年:羅莽湖 #4
programme.desc: 冬天溫和潮濕,對不同動物來說,是好消息,也可以是壞消息歐洲馬鹿被逼移到更高的地方,三文魚已經半年沒有食物,山兔變成了顯眼的白色,松鼠將自己的幼崽趕出巢穴

programme.title: 電腦遊戲:電玩的故事
programme.desc: 《電腦遊戲:電玩的故事》是一部關於電子遊戲歷史的專題紀錄片歷時近 5 年製作,跨越了從技術起源到街機遊戲誕生的時光從《乓》到《食鬼》,《超級瑪利歐》到《盜墓者羅拉》,《毀滅戰士》,《俠盜獵車手》等等,我們編纂有史以來發展最快的新媒體的非凡故事

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #1
programme.desc: 基努與加德拜訪提姆艾利斯--這位年輕執行長是相對論太空公司的創辦人,該公司打造並發射了全球第一枚3D列印火箭

programme.title: 空中戰士 10 #5
programme.desc: 從夜間追蹤任務到救援行動,了解MH-6小鳥直昇機如何在其他大型機體中贏得一席之地

programme.title: 空中戰士 10 #6
programme.desc: 細看大型軍用C-5銀河運輸機在超過半世紀的服役生涯中多次的高光時刻

programme.title: 休傑克曼:演藝巨星
programme.desc: 從百老匯舞臺到好萊塢巨片,休·傑克曼(Hugh Jackman)是他那代最具才華,最全能的表演者之一這部紀錄片追溯了他從澳洲的平凡起點,到憑藉金鋼狼一角名揚全球的星路歷程透過舞臺上的輝煌成就與個人的重重挑戰,我們將揭開這些角色背後,那位全心投入的演員,歌手以及人道主義者的真實面貌

programme.title: 阿姆斯壯
programme.desc: 《阿姆斯壯》戲劇性,感人且富有洞察力地講述尼爾巖士唐最完整的人生故事-從他在俄亥俄州鄉村的童年到他首次登月-以及伴隨而來非他所願的名人地位

programme.title: 揭秘芭比:分裂的夢幻屋

programme.title: 惠妮休斯頓: 天籟背後

programme.title: 犀牛孤兒院 #1
programme.desc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛

programme.title: 犀牛孤兒院 #2
programme.desc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂

programme.title: 犀牛孤兒院 #3
programme.desc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #6
programme.desc: 安斯利前往臺灣,發現它是世上最偉大的美食聖地之一他發現香燉魚和辣炒豬肉,並用大蒜和辣椒煮臺灣大蝦

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #7
programme.desc: 安斯利發現馬德裡是個充滿秘密的城市首先這個沉迷美食的城市禁止街頭美食那麼當地人如何繞過這道禁令呢?

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #8
programme.desc: 安斯利來到摩洛哥,但他沒有去馬拉喀什或卡薩布蘭加,而是去了豐富多彩,混亂而夢幻的費茲雜亂無序的麥地那是世界遺產,也是通往另一個時代的門戶

programme.title: 廣告界奇才 #4
programme.desc: 且看廣告商如何利用新的樂觀主義和新科技在貪婪是美德時代裡大賣產品

programme.title: 電腦遊戲:電玩的故事
programme.desc: 《電腦遊戲:電玩的故事》是一部關於電子遊戲歷史的專題紀錄片歷時近 5 年製作,跨越了從技術起源到街機遊戲誕生的時光從《乓》到《食鬼》,《超級瑪利歐》到《盜墓者羅拉》,《毀滅戰士》,《俠盜獵車手》等等,我們編纂有史以來發展最快的新媒體的非凡故事

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 2 #3
programme.desc: 文拿在紐奧良與食物歷史學家璽拉爬瑪和食譜作家添麥菲帕鋼一起探索一系列迷人的路易斯安素食名產--素貝涅餅,秋葵濃湯,餅乾和窮鬼三明治作為餐前後酒,他在紐奧良這座大城市中心一邊品酒一邊上雞尾酒調製的一課

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 2 #4
programme.desc: 文拿與拉斯維加斯傳奇魔術師佩恩吉列特吃飯他探索賭場大道以外的罪惡之城素食現場,沉溺於素威靈頓牛扒,超多層的窩夫和精緻的點心,然後與食譜作家卡妮博妯共進晚餐

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 2 #5
programme.desc: 文拿沐浴在陽光和拉丁文化中,學習製作經典的古巴菜和傳統的波多黎各素磨豐果他與食譜作家華迪迪芙路基亞一起揚帆出海,帶著演員麥梅利到南海灘品嚐垂涎欲滴的心太軟蛋糕,又採摘和品嚐令人驚豔的異國水果

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 2 #6
programme.desc: 文拿在日本的中心狼吞虎嚥著素壽司和拉麵他從新學習煮蕎麥麵,自製麻糬,並參加傳統茶道

programme.title: 美食足跡:南非 2 #1

programme.title: 美食足跡:南非 2 #3

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners Their large size is one of their features Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets

programme.title: Inside Maximum Security
programme.desc: 5 hardened criminals, 1 unique prison, in a ground-breaking observational documentary series, that will show you for the first time what prison is really like Changi Prison is a concret purgatory, spartan to the extreme There are no beds, no pillows and no chairs in the cells A shower is done stooping above a toilet hole Humiliating strip searches are routine, as a matter of security Yet, practiced in this prison are some of the most sophisticated methods to reform the hearts and minds of the most reclacitrant prisoners So much so that Singapore's reoffending rates are among the lowest globally Yet even at those low rates, at least 1-in-5 inmates are back in jail within 2 years after their release For the first time ever, six inmates, incarcerated multiple times, agree to reveal their full udentities, for our cameras to capture their lives behind bars, as they unfold Will the regime in jail finally be enough for them to renounce a life of crime? Will this be their final stint in Changi Prison?

programme.title: Sky's The Limit
programme.desc: A documentary exploring the muralist movement: the art of painting over breathtaking heights Windowless gable walls were graffiti painters’ early targets, particularly in urban areas under renovation, and since 2012, monumental graffiti is in full rebirth especially in Paris’ 13th arrondissement Through a design thought as a décor, obliterating the blandness of the walls, artists skillfully revive these soulless surfaces

programme.title: Where The Light Shines
programme.desc: Afghanistan's first ski team reach for a brighter future Where the Light ShinesFrom their amateur efforts at home in the Bamyan peaks, Sajjad and Alishah have the chance to ski for Afghanistan in the Winter Olympics As local kids strap wood to their feet and imitate their heroes, the men face up to the difficulty of creating opportunities in a country that for generations has only seen war Filmed over four years, this beautiful film paints an uplifting and refreshing portrait of Afghanistan as you haven't seen it before

programme.title: Outbreak Onboard
programme.desc: Cruise ships gave coronavirus a free ride around the world this Spring While infected passengers think the Ruby Princess should be sailed out to sea and sunk, its owner company is busy marketing post-Covid cruises Far from protecting people, the release of the ship’s passengers onto Australian shores triggered a public health emergency with the Ruby Princess now named as the single largest source of Australia’s coronavirus infections Tracey Temple, a passenger with underlying health conditions, is adamant that Princess Cruises forewent their duty of care “As far as I’m concerned, they never put our safety first” Pleas for information were met with reassurance from staff that “this ship is virus free” The cruise liner was ultimately called back to Sydney, but not before the virus had spread unchecked among the passengers, and unchallenged by social distancing measures Unaware of the public health disaster they were carrying, the passengers then dissipated not only across Australia, but the world “We thought we were going into the problem; we didn’t realise we were the problem,” says another passenger 850 passengers and crew from the ship contracted the virus,and at least 26 died

programme.title: Yasuni Man
programme.desc: A desperate struggle between conservationists and oil interests plays out, as the indigenous people living in the heart of the Ecuadorian Amazon struggle to preserve their way of life against encroaching modernity Filmmaker and biologist Ryan Patrick Killackey documents the staggering biodiversity of the Yasuni region at risk of destruction In the era of impending climate crisis, it's a more urgent story than ever

programme.title: The Neutral Ground
programme.desc: In 2015, CJ Hunt was filming the New Orleans City Council’s vote to remove four confederate monuments from the city A forceful group of critics protested the decision and fearing retaliation, no crew would agree to remove the statues CJ sets out to understand why a losing army from 1865 still holds so much power in America At once funny and furious, this film documents the USA's troubled romance with the Lost Cause

programme.desc: Discover China explores the Guqin, an ancient instrument Called “the sage’s instrument,” its delicate, somber tones weave tales of love and sorrow

programme.title: Aunty Moves in
programme.desc: Families call on some big-hearted but practical ‘Aunties’ to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life, from money woes to health problems and love life troublesReal people, real problems – there are times when families need nothing short of their own fairy godmother to help them through the rocky terrain of modern lifenFrom money woes to health problems, strife with the teenagers and love life troubles, AUNTY MOVES IN is a series that answers that call for help, in the form of the big-hearted Amiria Reriti and Ata Te Kanawa, real life aunties, who are also fully-qualified – with honours – from the University of Life

programme.title: Serial Swindlers
programme.desc: Exposing the world’s most convincing, creative, and criminally-adept con-men, Serial Swindlers goes inside their minds While their crimes and exploits are a ready-made Hollywood script, their exploits have left a trail of heartache, poverty and destruction

programme.title: Outbreak Onboard
programme.desc: Cruise ships gave coronavirus a free ride around the world this Spring While infected passengers think the Ruby Princess should be sailed out to sea and sunk, its owner company is busy marketing post-Covid cruises Far from protecting people, the release of the ship’s passengers onto Australian shores triggered a public health emergency with the Ruby Princess now named as the single largest source of Australia’s coronavirus infections Tracey Temple, a passenger with underlying health conditions, is adamant that Princess Cruises forewent their duty of care “As far as I’m concerned, they never put our safety first” Pleas for information were met with reassurance from staff that “this ship is virus free” The cruise liner was ultimately called back to Sydney, but not before the virus had spread unchecked among the passengers, and unchallenged by social distancing measures Unaware of the public health disaster they were carrying, the passengers then dissipated not only across Australia, but the world “We thought we were going into the problem; we didn’t realise we were the problem,” says another passenger 850 passengers and crew from the ship contracted the virus,and at least 26 died

programme.title: Yasuni Man
programme.desc: A desperate struggle between conservationists and oil interests plays out, as the indigenous people living in the heart of the Ecuadorian Amazon struggle to preserve their way of life against encroaching modernity Filmmaker and biologist Ryan Patrick Killackey documents the staggering biodiversity of the Yasuni region at risk of destruction In the era of impending climate crisis, it's a more urgent story than ever

programme.title: Ganz: How I Lost My Beetle
programme.desc: The Volkswagen Beetle is a design classic Celebrated by the Nazis, and championed by Hitler, the Beetle's true origins were obscured by a web of intrigue, espionage and slander This extraordinary doc reveals the untold story of Josef Ganz, the Jewish visionary behind one of the world's most adored cars As relatives search for traces of Ganz's legacy, they seek to recover the genius of a man edited out of history

programme.desc: There are senses we share with most animals, but what about those senses that human is equipped with? programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
高朋滿座#175粵
programme.desc: 溢與義欲到日本旅行，二人拆利是時，義發現每年家人在利是上「厚此薄彼」。溢向家人提起日本之行，眾長輩集資助他。義提出欲同行卻遭反對，一怒之下連飯也不吃，立即回房。義有感慶非常偏心，竟自暴自棄起來。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#20粵普PG
programme.desc: 裘千仞和楊康先後騙全真七子說黃藥師殺害周伯通和郭靖，梅超風不敵七子，歐陽鋒殺譚處端，梅超風護黃藥師而受傷…郭靖現身救與黃藥師對戰的江南六怪，黃藥師為他療傷後帶傻姑回桃花島，郭靖和黃蓉要去岳州找打狗棒。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 日本興起的「可樂餅」是炸薯餅，想食可樂味的「可樂餅」，肥媽自創煮法。肥媽的印尼式「番茄炒蛋」味道層次豐富，六號如何用印尼口音調戲雜貨店姐姐？還有「銀芽炒魷魚仔」和「芥菜鹹蛋肉片湯」，三餸一湯輕易完成。

programme.title: 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 來自選秀節目《魔音女團》的莊子璇、喬美莎、倪樂琳、宋宛穎、倪嘉雯、盧映彤等「星級」藝員參演的微短劇。故事描述Hilary(莊子璇)為了追尋唱跳夢，參加「超級新星」選拔；某天，她於偶然下發現「魔幻百變床褥」的神奇效果，毅然有所決定……

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 夏秋交替之際，若想利用鮮花為家居增添一份秋日氣息，如何挑選？此外，到來的花道教授亦會分享花卉作品，還即場示範製作精緻的「鮮花風鈴」。風鈴隨風擺動，為家中更添浪漫秋意。這次「跟大廚去搵食」，李偉強師傅帶領大王、菲比一同探索正宗韓式滋味。店內的韓式炸雞選用韓國走地雞炮製，肉嫩多汁，還有「醬豬蹄」、「水冷麵」、「八爪魚煎餅」等，都是地道的韓國美食。「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐炮製「皺皮椒菜脯炒腩片」。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 吃貨們要試澳門葡式口味，竟錯往珠海橫琴？原來是價錢作怪！豬扒包、焗豬扒飯與咖喱牛腩飯等澳葡美食、各有滋味秘訣。深圳潮汕菜食店內，食材船盛載多種即日海鮮讓顧客自選，每道菜式配以不同醬汁，為水產再提鮮！主持亦有隱世茶室推介，放鬆寫意度過下午。留港覓食，繼續有驚喜優惠。以花為主題的火鍋套餐，牛肉、特飲賣相精緻，額外加購七色丸子及餃子，更添口腹滿足感！另外，粥麵點心餐廳提供本地情懷套餐，人均不需百元。

programme.title: 天梯#6粵
programme.desc: 世雯出嫁時，新月懷疑丈夫不忠而忘記帶思行找世雯，幸得苗天協助讓世雯摸了牙縫。世章定讓世豪出任大查櫃，遭坤堯反對。新月發現愛娣住處，逼愛娣即時離開廣州。世章胸口劇痛送院，愛娣向新月道出自己與世章的關係。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 夏日炎炎，濱治提議舉行試膽大會，並邀請小丸子參加，小丸子一口答應，但小玉卻因患感冒未能同行。小丸子在電視上看過《福爾摩斯》後，立志成為偵探，並且成功替爺爺解開明信片寄件人之謎。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 四名男生分為曲奇、薯片小兵團，接受「廠長」蚌蚌公主指派的零食廠考驗。在「廠長話」遊戲中，有隊伍全員零失誤過關，順利獲得零食秘笈作獎勵。接着的果園收集任務中，薯片兵團表現亮眼。隊員為了爭分奪秒，甚至不惜手腳並用奮力爬行，最終僅用了不到三十秒，就成功「收集」到五種水果，速度驚人！兩隊於「溶化之橋」遊戲都勇敢挑戰高難度，分別選擇運送五個與六個雪糕球。最終雙方的結算數量僅僅相差一個，成績非常接近。

programme.title: 麵包超人粵日
programme.desc: 古琴妹妹準備去村中教小朋友們絃琴，並順便準備了一些竹筍飯請大家吃。細菌人知道之後，企圖奪取那些竹筍飯。鐵殼小子前往企鵝村派玩具，沿途受到細菌人襲擊，幸好得到小雪人仔出手相助。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 骨質疏鬆症是一種骨骼新陳代謝的病症，常見於長者，而女性一般在停經後會停止分泌雌激素，因此較男性更容易出現骨質疏鬆的情況。患者因為骨質密度減少，令骨骼結構變得脆弱，因而容易導致骨折、造成痛楚，以及引發其他併發症。值得留意的是，骨質疏鬆並非只是一個「老人病」，年輕女性若長期節食、曬太陽不足以及有家族史，都可能提早出現骨質疏鬆症。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 富途證券特約:富途講美股粵 及 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 西環發生狗隻咬傷人事件，狗主數日後再被發現無牽繩放狗，更有指該犬兩年前早有咬人前科？將軍澳某商場於中庭設置匹克球場，有途經市民被飛球擊中，認為圍網高度不足。馬鞍山街坊商場按摩店疑似提供色情服務事件，攝製隊安排男隊員假扮顧客光顧，按摩師其間提出加錢升級另類服務，店方翌日更推介另一分店有新晉年輕技師？應屆港姐三甲亮相領獎活動、女團MYNT出席參演微短劇的首映飯局、新節目《試真D唷》舉行記招，送上花絮。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#17粵
programme.desc: 唐芯開學在即，萬里特意安排各種「開學儀式」，祈求一切順利。原來唐芯小時候每逢開學都會肚痛，全靠萬里給她的「護身符公仔」才能安心上學。開學當天，唐芯因故匆匆出門，忘記帶上公仔；萬里憂心忡忡，趕往香港島大學欲把公仔交給她，卻意外聽到唐芯與盧漢娜的對話，得悉一個她不願接受的事實……萬里原本打算放手，不再刻意監察唐芯的動向；豈料其後察覺唐芯行為有異，調查下驚悉她正參與一項危險活動，遂急忙趕往島大……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#22粵PG
programme.desc: 曉彤暫代東馹主席，但內部勢力蠢蠢欲動，苓君着家謙要加倍支持曉彤。婉蘭向幸如、家謙訴說丈夫出軌，幸如擔心夢裡捉姦遇車禍的命運也會發生在婉蘭身上。幸如在制止婉蘭捉姦時，閃回一段失去的記憶……曉彤苦於處理東馹的千瘡百孔。Edmond為免影響曉彤，毅然辭職……婉蘭積極面對困境，幸如決心拯救婉蘭。繼威被安排協助幸如跟進保險廣告項目，幸如故意刁難他……

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#27粵普
programme.desc: 紀封發現閉路電視影片對蜜語不利，刪除影片以拖延時間，因此被解僱。蜜語愧疚不已，兩人分頭調查，蜜語想起送花瓶途中曾遇到房務員戴蕙，予誠又告訴她貞貞曾與其姐蜜瑤通電話；紀封跟蹤思源，發現他太太與貞貞會面…

programme.title: 玄戰粵PG
programme.desc: 「塔羅占星組」的四位黑先知接力登場，藉兩回合的玄學考驗大鬥法，爭奪兩個直接晉級的名額！本集神秘嘉賓曾經發生過一宗重大的意外，「星祭司」Hannah、「熊孩兒」Baebae、「微笑感應俠」Trevor、「黑貓之眼」BlackCat隔空連結，嘗試測算其事故發生的年齡、原因與影響。第二題的三位嘉賓以不同技藝，為社會默默付出，四位黑先知單憑外表與有限資料，能否測算出各人從事的工作行業？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
再創世紀#35粵PG
programme.desc: 天生故意讓明晞看到澤雨的死訊，但明晞反應冷淡。定垚聽着澤雨的遺言感悲痛，認定是天生派人殺死他。高哲查出天生會將烏托邦計劃賣給彼列後沽空，定垚擔心泡沫爆破會拖垮整個金融體系，說服程凱用超級電池救亡。可惜此舉未能阻止大市跌勢，突然有一神秘資金大手接貨。天生因沽空失利，大發雷霆，明晞意外發現天生藏起來的藥。內幕交易一案天生成功脫罪，隨即計劃啟動新一輪金融泡沫，定垚不忿，誓要找出天生的罪證！

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 吃貨們要試澳門葡式口味，竟錯往珠海橫琴？原來是價錢作怪！豬扒包、焗豬扒飯與咖喱牛腩飯等澳葡美食、各有滋味秘訣。深圳潮汕菜食店內，食材船盛載多種即日海鮮讓顧客自選，每道菜式配以不同醬汁，為水產再提鮮！主持亦有隱世茶室推介，放鬆寫意度過下午。留港覓食，繼續有驚喜優惠。以花為主題的火鍋套餐，牛肉、特飲賣相精緻，額外加購七色丸子及餃子，更添口腹滿足感！另外，粥麵點心餐廳提供本地情懷套餐，人均不需百元。

programme.title: 天梯#6粵
programme.desc: 世雯出嫁時，新月懷疑丈夫不忠而忘記帶思行找世雯，幸得苗天協助讓世雯摸了牙縫。世章定讓世豪出任大查櫃，遭坤堯反對。新月發現愛娣住處，逼愛娣即時離開廣州。世章胸口劇痛送院，愛娣向新月道出自己與世章的關係。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#175粵
programme.desc: 溢與義欲到日本旅行，二人拆利是時，義發現每年家人在利是上「厚此薄彼」。溢向家人提起日本之行，眾長輩集資助他。義提出欲同行卻遭反對，一怒之下連飯也不吃，立即回房。義有感慶非常偏心，竟自暴自棄起來。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#20粵普PG
programme.desc: 裘千仞和楊康先後騙全真七子說黃藥師殺害周伯通和郭靖，梅超風不敵七子，歐陽鋒殺譚處端，梅超風護黃藥師而受傷…郭靖現身救與黃藥師對戰的江南六怪，黃藥師為他療傷後帶傻姑回桃花島，郭靖和黃蓉要去岳州找打狗棒。

programme.title: 我是小廚神-新加坡篇粵普
programme.desc: 4強賽分兩個回合進行，分別以「水果」和「海鮮」作主題，出線的兩位小朋友會晉級總決賽。Tebo在水果戰表現失準，收拾心情後能否重拾信心？Leonika從容不迫、享受煮食過程的態度令評判另眼相看！鬼馬的Joshua喜擺甫士，奉上的精緻甜品「蘋果酥鬆餅」，能否俘虜女評判的心？Onaya遵從家傳食譜做出的海鮮米粉，味道如何？最終哪兩位獲評判張倩敏、楊國基和陳凱琳青睞，進入總決賽？

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
高朋滿座#176粵
programme.desc: 溢及悅的母親王艷群突然回港，但無面目與子女相認，竟暗中偷看他倆的工作情況。她更化名「Mary 姨」，刻意接近溢。溢聽到慶與義的談話後，竟萌生要尋找親生母親的念頭，但悅怒責溢不應如此，兩姊弟竟因此鬧翻。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#21粵普PG
programme.desc: 鐵掌幫幫主遭黃蓉羞辱，最終對決時還竟以出恭為名逃跑。拖雷催促郭靖與華箏成親，黃藥師見狀氣極，黃蓉反過來維護郭靖。楊康靠丐幫信物被推舉成新幫主；郭靖黃蓉遇上淨衣派長老，雖懷疑對方圖謀不軌卻仍中邪術被困…

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 「豬肉之最」是俗稱「第一刀」的豬頸背，到底它有多矜貴？且看肥媽示範「橙香第一刀」。魚香茄子煲令茄子煮得太腍，浪費其質感，肥媽可令茄子又爽又惹味。肥媽示範「娘惹海鮮醬燒鮫魚」及「老黃瓜花豆煲豬骨湯」。

programme.title: 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 來自選秀節目《魔音女團》的莊子璇、喬美莎、倪樂琳、宋宛穎、倪嘉雯、盧映彤等「星級」藝員參演的微短劇。故事描述Hilary(莊子璇)為了追尋唱跳夢，參加「超級新星」選拔；某天，她於偶然下發現「魔幻百變床褥」的神奇效果，毅然有所決定……

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 有指不少Z世代受中至重度抑鬱情緒困擾，精神科醫生認為這群組多自幼接觸社交媒體，缺乏面對面社交溝通，故較容易產生孤獨感。醫生詳析不同抑鬱程度對生活的影響，如嚴重甚至有自殺風險。近年AI聊天技術興起，抑鬱人士若多與AI傾訴，對病情可有幫助？髖關節骨折患者多為長者，原因與骨質疏鬆相關，也可能引發肺炎、深層靜脈血栓等。骨科醫生提到此症的死亡率偏高，並帶來診治資訊。「睇餸食飯」，德哥示範「鹹菜涼瓜燜腩肉」。

programme.title: 今晚請客粵
programme.desc: 黎諾懿、陳敏之第一晚請客，邀得愛下廚的龔嘉欣到臨。嘉欣不時在網上分享自家食譜，今集亦會展示拿手菜「乾燒大蝦」。諾懿擅長烹調海鮮，要輕鬆去除象拔蚌的內臟與外皮，有何秘訣？將蚌片放入上湯即焯即食，爽口鮮味！只要發揮創意，網紋哈密瓜也可變成可愛「飛天豬」，留意敏之示範。雞蛋看似平凡，卻能煮出千變萬化的滋味。諾懿巧手炮製「黃金蛋絲蝦球」，不單配菜講究，拉蛋絲的步驟亦有竅門！嘉欣另帶來零失敗的「鮮奶燉蛋」。

programme.title: 天梯#7粵
programme.desc: 濟民擔心世章，醫生說世章不會醒來，但新月不停呼喚下世章終醒來，在家人送別下離世，新月始知苗天是思行常說的好叔叔。世亮被販賣假犀角的騙子所騙，除客戶上門投訴，更有大批記者要求世亮交代出售假貨的事。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 姐姐有新的連身裙穿，小丸子大呼不公平，後來更趁姐姐不在時拿來偷穿，結果兩姊妹吵起上來。小丸子去做收音機體操，期間認識到一名自稱忍者後裔的老婦，聽她說完之後，小丸子對忍者產生濃厚興趣。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 太空看似遙不可及，這集「Kids’ Notes」嘉賓卻指日常生活上有不少用品，例如攝影器材和床褥，都啟發自太空科技及相關研究？主持對太空人的生活與飲食充滿好奇，嘉賓提到太空食物盡量都以擠壓技術製作，讓太空人可於無重狀態下進食，亦不會「洩漏」食物。太空人又如何清潔身體及休息補眠？在太空書寫也要有合適工具，他帶來太空筆，並示範水中寫字。另外，嘉賓曾與登月太空人見面聊天，藉此明白到太空人背後所花的努力。

programme.title: 麵包超人粵日
programme.desc: 棉花糖爺爺到處請人吃棉花糖。細菌人與紅精靈，假扮成果Jam叔叔與牛奶妹妹，來騙取棉花糖。細菌人企圖搶奪小朋友的糖果。當路過的ＢＢ超人正要出手阻止時，貓貓忍者也剛巧路過，並且出手對付細菌人。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
programme.desc: 大埔有新盤交樓，不過客廳牆身斜了，冷氣機圍欄難以打開，房間開窗時還會刮鉸，如何執修？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#18粵
programme.desc: 朱圓圓獲不少富二代追求，外表光鮮亮麗，實際卻過着與外界想像截然不同的生活。圓圓因故需另覓住處，唐芯提議她入住「開心小棧」，希望她透過社交平台宣傳小棧。圓圓發現小棧真正話事人的秘密，藉此向嘉驄提出各種要求。嘉驄苦不堪言，向萬里等人訴苦，詎料……圓圓存心折騰嘉驄，他亦惟有啞忍。其後，圓圓帶嘉驄選購家具時，竟與曾追求她的富二代及其女伴冤家路窄；為保面子，圓圓要求嘉驄假扮男友，嘉驄竟有意想不到的表現……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#23粵PG
programme.desc: 繼威工作上不斷被幸如等人羞辱，憤然辭職。他過檔至其昌麾下，誓要在幸如面前一雪前恥，沒想到於幸如巧妙的推波助瀾下，令繼威反過來得罪了廣告客戶。幸如、家謙查知繼威失業後宅在家中，與雪文關係惡化，更與模特兒Emma搞外遇，遂設計讓雪文捉姦……雪文終推斷出是幸如一直暗中推動一切，令自己不幸，氣煞找幸如攤牌，糾纏間意外令幸如回想起更多當天車禍中失落的記憶……

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#28粵普
programme.desc: 蜜語通過魏妻得知偷聽真相，紀封手持證據與思源對質，婉君報警將其帶走。紀封復職，帶領酒店贏下與寬利的對賭。貞貞被解僱並因竊取商業機密被捕。蜜語獲瑞士洛桑管理學院錄取，紀封支持她追夢，並承諾待其學成歸來…

programme.title: 玄戰粵PG
programme.desc: 本集出戰的「八字奇門組」四位黑先知是「天龍大少」天晉、「占星測量師」Vina、「定海神John」、「星曜布奇師」寶瑜。各人會透過八字卜卦、奇門遁甲等玄學修為，施展渾身解數！黑先知們獲給予一組時辰八字，需要測算神秘人物過往的婚姻經歷。另有三位蒙面男登場，當中某人有一段充滿波折的勵志人生。眾黑先知要於限時內藉着三人的資料猜出勵志者是誰，準確度與速度同要具備！經過兩回合測算，這組哪兩位黑先知能直接晉級？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
再創世紀#36粵PG
programme.desc: (大結局)定垚網上懸紅尋找天生的黑材料，明晞向天生提議收購天蔭來打擊定垚，定垚氣得出手掌摑明晞。天生目睹經過，放下對明晞戒心，明晞乘機引得天生親口承認買兇殺澤雨。警方通緝天生，但天生已畏罪潛逃。小慧故意要永廉教她健身，惹得程凱吃醋。澤雨生忌，程凱與小慧以智能家居的投射影像來悼念澤雨。高哲向定垚辭職，前往加拿大找思妤。定垚亦辭去傲堂主席一職，走到天涯海角，終於找到正在逃亡的天生……

programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: Sunday靚聲王粵
programme.desc: 早年劉鳳屏憑其嬌嗲的歌聲征服歌迷的心，被封為「嬌嬌女歌后」，今次回歸TVB舞台，任歌迷點唱，並與Liza姐、秋官，以及愛徒鄧佩儀、梁皓筠同場獻藝。此外，她還大派「福利」，首度於螢幕上獻唱英文歌。

programme.desc: 悅驚見溢新相識的朋友「Mary姨」正是她親生母親群。悅和群不欲在溢前發難，扮作互不相識。悅暗中要群放棄接近溢。悅往找慶及朋商量，慶認為群此番回港必另有所圖，更要二人保守秘密，卻因此被躲在一旁的麗聽到。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#22粵普
programme.desc: 楊康當著丐幫長老們的面求娶穆念慈，準備接任幫主之位後與穆念慈成親。丐幫大會上，楊康誣衊黃蓉和郭靖是殺害洪七公的兇手，二人被點了啞穴，無力反駁。此時，裘千仞受完顏洪烈所託，帶來了金銀珠寶，希望丐幫南下。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 野生菇菌不要採，想吃菇的話，肥媽教你烹調，又示範製作外脆內腍的「椒鹽鮮菇」。肥媽傳授「趕烏蠅大法」之餘，教你「炒烏蠅頭」！一道「饅頭墨魚煎餅」如何令隔夜饅頭起死回生？還有「簕莧菜赤小豆扁豆煲瘦肉湯」。

programme.title: 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 來自選秀節目《魔音女團》的莊子璇、喬美莎、倪樂琳、宋宛穎、倪嘉雯、盧映彤等「星級」藝員參演的微短劇。故事描述Hilary(莊子璇)為了追尋唱跳夢，參加「超級新星」選拔；某天，她於偶然下發現「魔幻百變床褥」的神奇效果，毅然有所決定……

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 《流行都市》為觀眾介紹時令產品、健康養生、健體運動、護膚化妝、時尚服飾、嬰幼兒護理、育兒知識、城中美食、飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗、示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識。烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱。

programme.title: 今晚請客粵
programme.desc: 響螺烹調前先要去除多個內臟部位，諾懿示範箇中技巧，再用螺肝製作伴碟醬汁。雞蛋、鵪鶉蛋如何變成可愛雞仔？敏之巧手做出「一家大細」。嘉賓陳煒透露自五歲起開始入廚，更試過為二百人煮菜。她到來炮製豪華佳餚「西班牙紅蝦天使麵」，入味麵條配以「爆膏」紅蝦，好滋味！「龍躉兩味」也可變出非一般美味？諾懿炮製炸薑絲，伴以蒸龍躉一同享用。煒哥教煮自家刴椒醬，再運用熱石來烘香魚片，奉上一道既惹味又有氣勢的「桑拿魚」。

programme.title: 天梯#8粵
programme.desc: 世亮耐不住壓力留書出走。苗天說出販賣假犀角的騙子之事，新月指坤堯安排一切害世亮。濟民表示要聘請鄭嬌、廣達及三斤。愛娣帶醉流連，被流氓施暴。美娟服藥後咳出血被送入院。坤堯父子到賀家，當眾提出分家。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子因天時暑熱食慾不振，遂請教一向腸胃弱的山根如何解決，前者逐漸康復，又開始想吃油膩食物。小丸子遇到一位替自行車取名字的大姐姐，覺得其說法有道理，遂仿傚她替各種東西取名字。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 這集「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，兒童體適能教練黃永輝首次登場，分別帶來下肢肌力訓練與核心力量訓練。過程中，黃Sir會加入豆袋與水樽作為輔助工具，還設計了拿豆袋擲向地面、把水樽推倒再拾起等動作，為鍛練注入趣味元素。另外，在AI生成動畫《亡羊補牢》的下半部中，農場主人因為遲遲未有修補羊圈，結果晚上再有羊被餓狼叼走。他痛定思痛，決心糾正過錯修補羊圈，最終不用再擔心羊群受到惡狼來襲。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 花騎士真誠的真正身分是風花堇師姐，大家都難以置信。阿源認為此事定有難言之隱，於是想試探阿堇的底細，可是她的言行並無絲毫破綻。為驅散陰沈氣氛，小奈提議大家外出遊玩。在遊玩途中，阿源重遇上次撞倒的女孩。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 男女選擇了對方作終身伴侶，憧憬著一段美滿的婚姻，但婚姻破裂，太太不再回家，兒女見不到媽媽，爸爸如何身兼母職？新聞掏寶和大家重溫2004年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

東張西望粵 及 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#19粵
programme.desc: 模型品牌EGO將舉辦全球宣傳活動，冠一致力爭取本地宣傳項目。前AI公司CEO Brian身敗名裂後轉戰玩具界，騙取大量EGO絕版模型，企圖藉舉辦玩具展牟暴利，卻遭網民揭發黑歷史。唐芯等人發現該網民正是小棧住客楊光，原來他亦是苦主之一。眾人聯手聲討Brian，Brian卻反發律師信，擬控告楊光誹謗。唐芯設法蒐集Brian罪證，行動中卻生變故。另一邊廂，楊帆竟與Brian合作，答應幫他對付唐芯等人……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#24粵PG
programme.desc: 幸如縱記起車禍當晚經過，惜看不清司機容貌。啟榮暗中派人跟蹤幸如、家謙。曉彤獲苓君協助，取得加入東馹董事局競選主席的資格，但這意味她要與家謙提早完婚。幸如終恍然某事的真相，大受衝擊；雖然如此，幸如仍對這事心存感恩……繼威向雪文示好，雪文以為繼威知錯，詎料……幸如看不過眼苓君擺弄家人以至自己的人生，當眾直斥其非……

programme.title: 百花殺#1粵普PG
programme.desc: 黨爭落敗，顧家全族被誅，唯一倖存者信王妃顧青梔飲下毒酒，以命為餌讓范家陪葬。昭寧郡主沈汐和赴京為太后賀壽並接受指婚，卻被推入水中，在幻境中與青梔相遇…太子蕭華雍意外救下汐和，青梔後在汐和身體中醒來…

programme.title: 玄戰直播粵
programme.desc: 自古以來，參透未來、扭轉乾坤的玄妙之術總是令人神往。然而，在流派百家爭鳴的當前，真正洞悉天機的能人，到底身在何方？注入直播元素的新節目《玄戰》，會掀開不一樣的戰幕。節目組廣邀潛藏民間的玄學高手化身「黑先知」，眾人務必通過重重嚴苛關卡，爭奪晉級資格。海選中表現最好五人獲賦以「白先知」身分，並與突圍而出的黑先知開展對壘。這是一場賭上名譽與實力的玄學之戰，究竟誰人可破譯天機、洞悉玄奧，成為「一代先知」？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵

究竟天有幾高#1粵
programme.desc: 二零一零年，大學教授榮杰帶領的香港科研團隊，要為「嫦娥三號」研發相機指向系統，他發現學生張寧對航天研究充滿熱誠，遂邀她加入團隊。團隊終於完成任務，成員們開心不已。團隊及後要為嫦娥五號開發表面採樣的裝置，張寧埋首研發之際，好友王志強、文世賢、張春生卻因不同理由離開團隊，令張寧陷入迷惘……二零二零年，嫦娥五號即將升空，張寧跟榮杰一同見證歷史。她的三位好友縱沒有參與其中，仍為團隊的成功大感雀躍。

programme.desc: 農夫以故事形式介紹嘉賓JW王灝兒、梁釗峰、關楚耀與On仔（陳健安），Do姐可會收貨？曼谷的女化妝師擅長甚麼妝容？揭曉答案時還加映胡慧冲特別演出！來到「試食題」，名廚巧製「有營芝士餅」，究竟加入甚麼食材？楚耀和On仔藉「大大貼士」成功搶分，提示有多明顯？東京的監獄病院餐廳內，疑似肝臟的食品用甚麼製成？兌換環節，釗峰竟稱四個地方「各有鞦韆」；隊友JW更公開二人「親密聯繫」，引來連環笑聲！

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 農夫發揮創意介紹今集嘉賓陳山聰、陳敏之，總算得到Do姐的「OK」評級。「問題專員」陳雅思拜訪「濟州石敢當」，傳說觸摸石像某部位可保健康？巴黎一部「特大自助洗衣機」原來另有玄機！Do姐說出「洗衣機沒有電子裝置」的沒用貼士，對兩隊可有啟發？台北的「一人餐廳」在餐桌上放着一款牙醫工具，卻並非放進口中，究竟得物何所用？山聰與敏之帶着相同積分進入兌換獎金環節，但最終出現天堂與地獄的結果！

programme.desc: 動物園可真是個瘋狂的地方！原本不在同一片大陸的動物，如今都在一起共同生活。但對一群好朋友來說，動物園就是他們的家！這裡有活潑好動的大象拉拉、聰明的鱷魚沃比、害羞的白虎咪噗、俏皮的水獺可可子，還有勇敢的鴿子狄爾，快來和我們一起認識這群朋友吧！

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎
programme.desc: 【姜素拉化身訴訟女神離婚怨偶再擦出火花】所謂「相愛容易，相處難」，恩範&荷拉已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因男方外遇出軌導致離婚收場。專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉，時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題，對她來說前夫只是「行走的贍養費」。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司被客戶追著跑，窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表，簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」前夫恩範，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 【羅美蘭化身高年級實習生道盡女性職場家庭壓力】曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場、找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手、如今成為上司的崔智媛。在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎。劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭、工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 【羅美蘭化身高年級實習生道盡女性職場家庭壓力】曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場、找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手、如今成為上司的崔智媛。在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎。劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭、工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴。

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎(完)
programme.desc: 【姜素拉化身訴訟女神離婚怨偶再擦出火花】所謂「相愛容易，相處難」，恩範&荷拉已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因男方外遇出軌導致離婚收場。專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉，時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題，對她來說前夫只是「行走的贍養費」。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司被客戶追著跑，窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表，簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」前夫恩範，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 青春時代2
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 青春時代2
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: 異想天開木瓜島(完)
programme.desc: 歡迎來到木瓜島！這是一個與世隔絕的地方，有著獨特又古怪的傳統，木瓜島的每個孩子都有小牛看護者，除了一個不知怎麼來到島上的孩子－－卡庫佩，經過種種努力，終於得到一隻神經質的小牛蘇格拉底。而這對特別的搭檔，將會挑戰木瓜島的傳統……

programme.title: 小小動物歷險記
programme.desc: 動物園可真是個瘋狂的地方！原本不在同一片大陸的動物，如今都在一起共同生活。但對一群好朋友來說，動物園就是他們的家！這裡有活潑好動的大象拉拉、聰明的鱷魚沃比、害羞的白虎咪噗、俏皮的水獺可可子，還有勇敢的鴿子狄爾，快來和我們一起認識這群朋友吧！

programme.title: 異想天開木瓜島(完)
programme.desc: 歡迎來到木瓜島！這是一個與世隔絕的地方，有著獨特又古怪的傳統，木瓜島的每個孩子都有小牛看護者，除了一個不知怎麼來到島上的孩子－－卡庫佩，經過種種努力，終於得到一隻神經質的小牛蘇格拉底。而這對特別的搭檔，將會挑戰木瓜島的傳統……

programme.title: 小小動物歷險記

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎(完)
programme.desc: 【姜素拉化身訴訟女神離婚怨偶再擦出火花】所謂「相愛容易，相處難」，恩範&荷拉已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因男方外遇出軌導致離婚收場。專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉，時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題，對她來說前夫只是「行走的贍養費」。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司被客戶追著跑，窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表，簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」前夫恩範，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 【羅美蘭化身高年級實習生道盡女性職場家庭壓力】曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場、找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手、如今成為上司的崔智媛。在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎。劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭、工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 青春時代2
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 青春時代2
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is a curious little robot who loves making friends, discovering new things, and having fun with music, magic, animals, and more. Every day is a new adventure for Rookie—whether he’s chasing a bouncing ball, exploring the stars, or learning how something works. He’s always ready to laugh, try again when things get tricky, and share big smiles with the friends he meets along the way. With Rookie, even the smallest moments become exciting discoveries!

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - Sabotaje
programme.desc: Chip es un niño de 9 años que prefiere jugar con sus compañeros antes de las clases de física y química con su maestra Susan. Un día, durante una visita escolar al Instituto de Alta Energía, un científico loco, el Dr. No, está realizando un experimento con una lente capaz de convertir materia en antimateria, lo que provoca un accidente y un rayo incontrolado que lanza a Chip y al científico a la dimensión del micromundo. Chip se da cuenta de que el accidente lo ha enviado a un lugar desconocido y no sabe cómo regresar. Unos átomos de hierro, mercurio e hidrógeno, representados como Fer, Merc e Hidro, lo guiarán para ayudarlo a encontrar el camino de vuelta. Al mismo tiempo, el Dr. No descubre que, debido al accidente, ha logrado crear antimateria, y el poder que esto le otorga lo prepara para convertirse en el amo del mundo.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La corriente electrica
programme.desc: Fer, Merc e Hidro llevan a Chip a la Ciudad Atómica, donde hay noticias de otro humano, el Dr. No, que ha llegado al micromundo. Chip piensa que tal vez el Dr. No podría ayudarlo a regresar a su dimensión, y va a verlo para devolverle la lente que el científico perdió durante el viaje al micromundo. Pero el Dr. No está construyendo la Torre Negra, una poderosa máquina que lo ayudará a esclavizar a todos los átomos del micromundo. Ahora tiene muchos trabajando bajo sus órdenes, y los lanza contra Chip y sus amigos para convertirlos en prisioneros y arrebatarles la lente. Al escapar, Chip cae en una corriente eléctrica que lo transporta muy lejos.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El castillo de Robins
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La trampa de la armonica
programme.desc: Chip y sus amigos crean una zona con formaciones que se asemejan a instrumentos musicales y armonizan sus sonidos. De repente, quedan atrapados en un rectángulo de cristales de cuarzo que vibran al formar una trampa sónica. Un átomo músico, que los ha capturado, busca miembros para formar una orquesta. Los antimateriales están cerca y Chip le pide al músico que prepare la trampa para retenerlos y escapar. El músico acepta y los antimateriales se convierten en prisioneros, obligándolos a escuchar el terrible sonido de sus composiciones.

programme.title: Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Yusuf’s best friend, Memo falls gravely ill. Isolated in their boarding school located in the snowy mountains, tensions run high as Yusuf’s calls for help for Memo becomes increasingly difficult in the face of an authoritarian and bureaucratic system.

programme.title: Easy Living
programme.desc: A 14-year-old kid, a young woman who smuggles medicines up and down the Italian border with France and a bizarre American tennis teacher who dreams of being a painter. Their lives take a turn when they meet an illegal migrant.

programme.title: Human Capital
programme.desc: Lake Como, Italy. A cyclist is hit off the road by a jeep in the night before Christmas Eve. What happened that night? How will this accident change the destiny of the rich Bernaschi family and the Rovelli family on the edge of bankruptcy?

programme.title: Helen Dorn: After The Storm
programme.desc: After a celebration in her rural hometown, Karla Petersen is murdered on her way home. Inspector Helen Dorn takes on the case but clashes with local officer Tom Petersen, Karla's brother, who defies warnings to find his sister's killer.

programme.title: Wonderfully Beautiful
programme.desc: Ranging from a 60-year-old retiree who no longer finds herself desirable to a daughter trying to make her breakthrough as a model, five women of different ages confront their self-image and the expectation they have for themselves and the people around them.

programme.title: Lost In Marseille
programme.desc: Bruno, a stay-at-home father of two, gets back in touch with his masculinity when his wife is kidnapped in Marseille. Instead of the planned holiday on the Côte d'Azur, Bruno gets deeper and deeper into an intrigue, pursued by police and mafia.

programme.title: Lucky Girl
programme.desc: TV star Nina Sokil is diagnosed with bone cancer, but deeming her career to be more important with her health, Nina goes to absurd lengths to hide her condition so that she keeps working.

programme.title: Three Quarter Moon
programme.desc: Hartmut, a taxi-driver, is left in a bitter slump when his wife leaves him. That is, until he gets six-year-old Hayat and her mother in his taxi. In a serendipitous turn of events, Hayat is left under his care and she helps him learn to enjoy life again.

programme.title: Helen Dorn: Breathless
programme.desc: In an illegal arms case, three men, including two policemen, are dead. Mattheisen reveals a radical right-wing conspiracy, and suspects a mole. However, he is shot dead with Inspector Dorn’s weapon, while Dorn is found at the crime scene with no memory.

programme.title: Behind the Mountains
programme.desc: After spending four years in jail for vandalizing his place of work, Rafik has only one plan, take his son to the mountains and show him his amazing discovery.

programme.title: The Cave Of The Yellow Dog
programme.desc: Nansal, a Mongolian nomadic girl finds a puppy and brings it home but her father believes it to be bad luck. But when the dog saves the family’s baby, he finally accepts it. Central to this tale is the belief in the cycle of rebirth between man and dog.

programme.desc: Sisters Tae and Yo return to their childhood home and discover a box of recipes and letters from their late Japanese mother. As Tae uncovers her mother’s hidden struggles, she journeys to Taiwan to retrace her past through memory and food.

programme.desc: Jean-Pierre Werner, a revered and devoted country doctor, discovers that he is suffering from an inoperable tumor. As a doctor from the city arrives to help him with his practice, Werner is troubled by the thought that he is no longer irreplaceable.

programme.desc: 70-year-old Willi catches Malian refugee Nama stealing, but decides not to report him. Having been a refugee once, Willi sees a part of himself in Nama, and brings him home. However, Nama’s decision further frays his relationship with his son.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Trailer
programme.desc: When it's time for the Tubby Custard Ride, there's a special trailer the Teletubbies haven't seen before. It's for The Noo-­Noo who gets to go on a special Tubby Custard Ride.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S01 - Hat
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say hat and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different hats - a small hat, a big hat - even a wooly pink pig hat! There's a pretty flower hat and a funny tower hat. The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S02 - Vote Okido
programme.desc: Mayor Oki and Geoffrey are making a lot of noise in the election for the next Mayor of OKIDO.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Pizzas Away
programme.desc: Mojo needs to deliver a pizza to a very hard-to-reach island, but some stubborn seabirds have their eye on the pizza. Will Mojo have to go supersonic to get past them?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Slide
programme.desc: Bingo and Lila are excited to play on their new waterslide.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - TV Shop
programme.desc: At the chemist, Bluey and Bingo have fun playing with the CCTV screens.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Sibling Badge
programme.desc: It's news time at the Clubhouse, and the Squirrels share their exciting news of the week with each other. Happy got a new bath sponge, Norrie is growing a sunflower and Roly, after thinking hard if he's got any news at all, remembers he's getting a new brother or sister. The Squirrels have all sorts of questions to ask.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Why Badge
programme.desc: All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one, poor Tag whose feet hurt. 'Why do my feet hurt?', he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Stick Together
programme.desc: Have you seen Duggee? Help the Squirrels search for him, but they need to stick together!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ping Pong Penguins
programme.desc: What’s that bouncy, pingy, whacking sound? It’s the Penguins playing ping-pong!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Panama Canal, Panama
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch is late for the European Moustache of the Year award ceremony, and even worse, he's broken down! The Grimbots are on hand to recommend a shortcut: the Panama Canal, a man-made passage that provides a gateway between the Pacific and Atlantic oceans. Meanwhile, the Go Jetters are also heading to the Panama Canal to see its huge watery steps in action, but they arrive to find honking ships' horns and a huge traffic jam - it's all been glitched!

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Backpackers
programme.desc: Mum and Dad are going on an adventure wearing the kids as their cheeky backpacks! Seeing the sights and buying street food, backpacking is a blast - until they lose their passports.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Bad Mood
programme.desc: Bingo is playing Bad Mood with Dad, standing on his feet as Dad stomps around the house, controlling everything Bingo does and causing chaos.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Sheep Dog
programme.desc: Dad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest, but looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Housework
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Hatzegopteryx Display
programme.desc: When Jen's drone goes missing on Dino Island, Andy heads out to track it down. He discovers one of the island's inhabitants, a giraffe-sized pterosaur, called Hatzegopteryx, is using the drone for a very special purpose.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Cup
programme.desc: Bella plays with her favourite cup - it makes the perfect drum for a sing along with Lift. Together, they visit Kingsley and Queenie who play the 'Tea Party Dash', but who will win?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Lost Property Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels have just got some new walkie-talkies and are having so much fun with them. Duggee calls the Squirrels to come for some blueberry juice, but as Tag is running, he trips over a car and falls through a secret door in the wall! Communicating through his walkie-talkie, Tag doesn't know where he is. He can see lots and lots of things around him but no one has any idea where this room is in the house!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Pet Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels meet a scruffelump in the woods, and despite Duggee's reservations, take him in. But they soon learn the responsibilities of taking care of a pet.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Choreography Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are out doing their exercises when suddenly, a cheetah called Chipo comes along with his dance crew. He criticises them for not being able to dance in time, and it turns out Duggee used to be part of the dance crew! Duggee was a great dancer, but he never stuck to the choreography and was always making up his own moves.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - Giant's Causeway, Northern Ireland
programme.desc: A Giant Grandmaster Glitch means BIG trouble for the Giant's Causeway - can the Go Jetters stop him in his tracks?

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Wieliczka Salt Mine, Poland
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch's digging floods Wieliczka Salt mine. The Go Jetters must save the famous salt statues.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Lorenzo's Solo
programme.desc: Lorenzo decides to play a dangerous trick on his loyal coach Beppe. However, he soon realises that taking the legendary opera star Dame Bella Canto to the music festival wasn't the best idea.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Beach Break
programme.desc: Sarah and Duck are spending a day at the beach, aiming to build some sand animals.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Bubble Bumbling
programme.desc: The Bubble Man is in town so a visit to the Big Shop is in order for Sarah, Duck and Donkey.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - First Aid
programme.desc: Myrtle calls Stanley to see if she can practice her first aid skills on him, but he's all fit and healthy. Instead, they go about the town making good use of Myrtle's newfound abilities.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Bug Hotel
programme.desc: Benjamin and Sophie have a new bug friend. Stanley helps build a bug feeder which attracts lots more bugs. They eat so much; Stanley gets more food and builds a Bug Hotel for them.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - Penguins Live in Igloos
programme.desc: Rain, hail, sunshine, and making snow giraffes! The animals chat about everything they love about their favourite seasons.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S03 - It's Time For An Easter Feast
programme.desc: JoJo, Gran Gran and all the family plan an Easter feast. When there isn't enough space in the kitchen to prepare the food, it's time for a Gran Gran plan outside in the garden.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Stickbird
programme.desc: On a trip to the beach, Mum teaches Bluey to throw, while Bingo and Dad get creative with a funny shaped stick.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Show and Tell
programme.desc: Bluey wants to know why Dad's always bossing her around.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dragon
programme.desc: When Bluey needs some assistance drawing a dragon for a story she is working on, she asks her dad, Bandit, for help.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Recipe Badge
programme.desc: The hungry Squirrels turn to Duggee when they aren't sure what to eat. Fortunately, he has his cookbook The Clubhouse Kitchen: Tasty Bites for Hungry Squirrels.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Nature Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels can learn more about nature and wildlife if they follow five easy steps: watch carefully, stay at a distance, don't interfere, be patient and alert, and stay quiet.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Say Cheese
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn about butterflies and tortoises.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Rainforests of Sumatra, Indonesia
programme.desc: When Grandmaster Glitch invents the world's most pungent perfume, he finds he needs one more ingredient: the super stinky aroma of the titan arum, a huge flower that blooms once every few years in the rainforests of Sumatra.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Brussels Sprout
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's tiny Brussels Sprout performing I'm Mighty and proving how great he is.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Tomato
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits Theatre, Tomato changes colour.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Super Sandcastle
programme.desc: Supertato and the Veggies have built a super sandcastle, but Evil Pea wants to storm it by firing her hordes of Mini Peas at it with her pea shooter.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Walkie Talkie
programme.desc: The veggies are playing walkie-talkie hide-and-seek, but Evil Pea steals Carrot's walkie-talkie and uses it to trick the Veggies into getting trapped by the Corn Cobs.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Say Hello
programme.desc: Tinky Winky and Laa-­Laa are in Home Dome when the Tubby Phone rings. It's Dipsy and Po calling from the Tubby Mobile to say 'Hello'.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S01 - Worm
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say worm and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see a long worm, a little worm and a squirmy worm! Look out for the speedy worm and the greedy worm, the jelly worm and the welly worm! Dee enjoys a glow worm and we see a little girl make a muddy worm from her finger! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S02 - Snowdens Ear-mergency
programme.desc: Snowden has lost his pine cone ears. Will Messy and his chums find them in time for his performance in the OKIDO Ice Skating Extravaganza?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Piggyin the Riddle
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo need to move a crashed meteor. But every time Mojo goes near the big rock, moving turns to grooving. How can you move a meteor if you can't stop dancing?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Cricket
programme.desc: During a friendly game of neighbourhood cricket, the dads struggle to bowl Rusty out.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Slide
programme.desc: Bingo and Lila are excited to play on their new waterslide.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Monster Badge

The Squirrels are keen to help Plinky get in touch with her scary side. Fortunately, Duggee has his monster badge.

programme.desc: Duggee looks all around, but can he find the Squirrels? Let’s play Hide and Seek!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Stick Together
programme.desc: Have you seen Duggee? Help the Squirrels search for him, but they need to stick together!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Tower Bridge, London
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch is visiting London and spots the perfect souvenir hat. But he's run out of pocket money, so he decides to earn some as a tour guide. programme.title: Bluey S01 - The Adventure
programme.desc: Princesses, horses and magic wands. Bluey and Chloe can play any role they want, when they embark on an adventure to save their playground kingdom from the Greedy Queen.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Octopus

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Housework
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Muffin Cone
programme.desc: When Muffin can't stop sucking her thumb, she has to wear a cone of shame. But the cone gets in her way and she can no longer play `sandwich shop' with Bluey and Bingo.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Perfect
programme.desc: For her Father's Day card, Bluey sets out to draw a picture of herself and her father together. While recalling her favourite memories of playing with Bandit, Bluey struggles with the idea that her drawing must be perfect. Chilli tries to convince Bluey that perfection isn't easy, or absolutely necessary.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Explorers
programme.desc: While waiting to be picked up from school, Jack plays at being a sailor trying to find his way back home to Australia. Meanwhile, Jack's Dad has got lost on route to collect him.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Velociraptor
programme.desc: When Andy loses his gizmo and gets lost in the dark, a friendly velociraptor comes to his aid.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Mud
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Cloud Kitchen, where Patch is busy with the Playtimers making a tasty treat called Munchy Muddy Meadows.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Ambition Badge
programme.desc: Duggee masters his ambition of building a model of the Clubhouse out of sticks. This encourages the Squirrels to think of their own ambitions, and how they can achieve them.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Accessory Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels see Duggee accessorising his tie and want to learn how to do it themselves. All of the Squirrels accessorise an item and showcase their goods.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Mountain Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels need to rescue Enid when they see her at the top of the Mighty Sugar Bun Mountain.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - Big Ben, England
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are on a mission to get Big Ben back to the Elizabeth Tower in time for it to chime at midnight! To the Vroomster!

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.desc: When Grandmaster Glitch supersizes a fierce Komodo dragon, the Go Jetters must find the sizeray to fix the glitch.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Out of Site
programme.desc: Brenda learns that it is important to work as a team and not just care about her own jobs.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Tummy Talk
programme.desc: When Sarah forgets her sandwich, her rumbling tummy inadvertently starts a conversation.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Moon's Exhibition
programme.desc: A trip to the art gallery unexpectedly helps Duck with the hunt for his lost toy Rhino.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Wonder Vole
programme.desc: Benjamin can't find his favourite toy, Wonder Vole anywhere. Stanley suggests they retrace his steps but have no luck. Maybe Wonder Vole Pyjamas will help Benjamin feel brave.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Treat
programme.desc: Stanley's friends throw him a birthday party. No work for Stan today. Cynthia and Jose take a call from Amare, her tractor is stuck in the mud. Soon, so are all Stanley's vehicles.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I Don't Like Bananas
programme.desc: From broccoli soup to cheeseburgers and blue cheese, the funny animals chat about the best and worst things to eat.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S03 - It's Time for a Surprise
programme.desc: JoJo, Gran Gran and Panda are helping Cynthia in her garden - JoJo loves how tall the sunflowers are. Cynthia gives JoJo a present of some sunflower seeds - JoJo can keep them ready to plant and grow more sunflowers next year. When she gets home, JoJo decides it would be nice to give Cynthia a surprise, but what can she give her? It's time for a Gran Gran plan as JoJo and Gran Gran work out what Cynthia would like - after all, everyone likes different things.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Wild Girls
programme.desc: Coco wants to play Wild Girls with Indy, but Chloe wants her to play another game.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - TV Shop
programme.desc: At the chemist, Bluey and Bingo have fun playing with the CCTV screens.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Slide
programme.desc: Bingo and Lila are excited to play on their new waterslide.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Face Painting Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are looking for Duggee but can't find him. Instead, they find someone they think is Enid, only much too big... Duggee has painted his face to look like Enid! Of course, the Squirrels want their faces painted too, so Duggee sets to it.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Carrot Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are admiring Duggee's crop of giant carrots when they hear a noise. They find the Rabbits busy preparing for the Carrot Solstice.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Animals
programme.desc: The Squirrel club play games involving animals. The chickens do some rhythmic office work.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Avenue of the Baobabs, Madagascar
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch tries his hand at stunt flying, but the Grimbots are unimpressed, giving him a unanimous thumbs down. He tries again, but it's one loop-the-loop too much for poor old Grim HQ and it crash-lands in the branches of a baobab tree. Meanwhile, the Go Jetters enjoy the peaceful nighttime views of the Avenue of the Baobabs in Madagascar - a stand of trees known as 'the upside down trees' because their branches look like roots, reaching up into the sky.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Carrot
programme.desc: Carrot sings about being trendy.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Watermelon
programme.desc: Watermelon performs a body tap routine.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Sweetieland Saga
programme.desc: Evil Pea cheats Chilli out of winning floofy teddies at a funfair made from sweets, so Supertato and the Veggies must get the teddies back before it's too late!

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Monstertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea creates an evil version of her nemesis, Supertato. With the help of her hench-Cobs, Evil Pea makes a big, green lumbering spud that she names Monstertato!

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Honk Honk
programme.desc: The Teletubbies hear a 'honk honk' in the distance and the Tubby Car approaches. The Tubby Car drives the Teletubbies across Teletubbyland as they sing the Tubby Car song.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S01 - House
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say house and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different houses; a small house, a tall house and a hen house! There's a lighthouse, a bright house, a bee house and a tree house. And of course, the most important house of all, 'My house!' The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S02 - Messy Has a Hoot
programme.desc: Messy and his friends go on a camping trip in OKIDO Forest with Tweedie the Explorer and meet a few more nocturnal animals than they bargained for.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Breakdown Bryan
programme.desc: Bryan the ferry can't shut his engine off, so he's speeding out of control around the lake. How will Mojo and Bo get aboard to take control and steer Bryan to safety?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Obstacle Course
programme.desc: Mum sets up a backyard obstacle course just for fun, but Dad wants to race! Now the kids are determined to win by any means necessary.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Bedroom
programme.desc: Bluey is excited to get her own room. But when bed time comes, she misses Bingo more than she expected and must find a way to stay in touch with her sister.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Metal Detector Badge
programme.desc: It's a lovely day, so everyone is playing outside. Things take a turn when Roly needs a wee, because the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. The Squirrels start looking around for it, but they have no luck. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector, Helen. After demonstrating it to the Squirrels, they are very keen to give it a go.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Diary Badge
programme.desc: The day starts when Duggee moves a cupboard, and the Squirrels find a dusty, old book behind it. It's Duggee's diary from when he was a teenager! The Squirrels aren't sure what a diary is, so Duggee explains by reading some extracts. The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - El Gran Final
programme.desc: Join the chickens in space for the big finale of Agony and Eggstacy! Mucho Suspense!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Dr. Catastrophe
programme.desc: The Super Squirrels are called to action! Time to stop Dr Catastrophe and save their toys!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Go Jet Academy: Biogas Power
programme.desc: Glitch is excited when Lars refits the Grimbler with new, clean biogas boosters that could make it even faster than the Vroomster! The boosters run on gas made from food waste, and luckily there is plenty of leftover food in the academy canteen for the Grimbots to gather up. But Glitch overloads the boosters and BOOM!
